name: Kuwaimu no Chikahigoto
original_name: くわいむのちかひごと
source:
The main character makes a promise with a demon in her dreams.
Her grandmother, in fear of her being taken away by the demon,
asks her not to make any more promises, but...
Will the promise she already made come true in real life? Or only in her dreams?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29380]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角在梦中与恶魔许下承诺。
她的祖母害怕她被恶魔带走，
要求她不要再做出任何承诺，但是……
她曾经许下的诺言在现实生活中会实现吗？还是只在她的梦里？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29380]Freem![/url]]
